findings.latin: Ex quo patet quod impossibile est Deum aliquo modo mutari.
findings.current: mustahil Allah dapat berubah dengan cara apa pun
findings.suggested: mustahil Allah berubah dengan cara apa pun
findings.why: The Latin denies that God is changed ('mutari'); the extra modal from the English 'changeable' doubles the modality under 'impossibile'.

findings.latin: in Deo nulla est compositio, sed est omnino simplex
findings.current: tidak ada susunan apa pun, sebab Ia sepenuhnya sederhana
findings.suggested: tidak ada susunan apa pun, melainkan Ia sepenuhnya sederhana
findings.why: 'Sed' states the positive side of the same proposition that was shown in q.3 a.7; it does not give a reason ('for' in the English).

findings.latin: cum sit infinitus / qui sua infinitate omnia loca replet
findings.why: Unified terms §B name q9 explicitly: infinitum/infinitas → tak terbatas/ketakterbatasan (paired with 'virtute sua finita' → 'terbatas' in the same sentence).

findings.latin: inquantum radius luminis eius usque ad terram pertingit
findings.why: Unified terms §E: lumen → terang (this spot is listed); 'pertingit' is reaching, the same verb as in ad 3, not touching.

findings.latin: inquantum percipimus influentiam bonitatis ipsius, vel ab eo deficimus
findings.current: ketika kita menerima aliran kebaikan-Nya atau berpaling dari-Nya
findings.suggested: sejauh kita menerima aliran kebaikan-Nya atau berpaling dari-Nya
findings.why: 'Inquantum' gives the respect in which the metaphor holds (parallel to the sun's rays in the same sentence), not a time ('when' in the English).

findings.current: seperti semua orang yang berbahagia di surga
findings.suggested: seperti semua orang kudus di surga
findings.why: Unified terms §E: beati → para kudus di surga (this spot is listed); 'orang' replaces 'para' only because 'omnes' precedes it.

findings.latin: creaturae / omnis creatura / in omni creatura / nullum creatum
cum privatione formae substantialis / privationem accidentis / privatio illius accidentis / privationem formae / privationem huius loci vel illius / privationem huius actus
findings.suggested: kekurangan (yaitu tidak adanya sesuatu yang semestinya ada) forma …; kekurangan aksiden / forma / tempat / aktus
findings.why: Unified terms §C: privatio → kekurangan, with the standard gloss at first occurrence (q9 a2, 6× listed).

findings.latin: quia materia eorum potest esse cum privatione formae substantialis ipsorum
findings.current: sejauh materinya dapat berada dalam keadaan tanpa forma substansialnya
findings.suggested: karena materinya dapat berada bersama kekurangan … forma substansialnya
findings.why: 'Quia' gives the cause of substantial mutability, not a respect ('inasmuch as' in the English).

findings.latin: per potentiam quae est in altero, scilicet in Deo, sunt mutabiles
findings.current: karena daya pihak lain, yakni Allah
findings.suggested: karena kuasa yang ada pada pihak lain, yakni pada Allah
findings.why: Unified terms §D: God's potentia → kuasa (this spot is listed); 'in altero … in Deo' is also locative, not possessive.

findings.latin: subiiciuntur tamen variationi, inquantum subiectum secundum eas variatur
findings.current: tunduk pada perubahan karena melalui forma-formalah subjeknya berubah-ubah
findings.suggested: tunduk pada perubahan sejauh subjeknya berubah-ubah menurut forma-forma itu
findings.why: 'Inquantum' limits how forms are subject to variation (only through the subject varying according to them), which is the point of the reply; 'because' in the English turns it into a cause.

lessons: [asal: STh I q.9] 'Inquantum' dalam analogi (matahari dan sinarnya, subjek dan forma) → 'sejauh', bukan 'ketika' atau 'karena'. Bahasa Inggris 1920 sering menjadikannya 'when' atau 'because', sehingga pembatasnya hilang.
[asal: STh I q.9] Setelah 'mustahil'/'impossibile est' jangan menambah 'dapat' pada verba Latin pasif indikatif (mutari, moveri); modalitasnya sudah ada pada 'mustahil'.
[asal: STh I q.9] 'Nulla est X, sed est Y' → 'tidak ada X, melainkan Y', bukan 'sebab Y'; 'sed' tidak memberi alasan.

[asal: STh I q.9] Dalam pembagian 'per potentiam quae in ipso est / in altero est', bila 'alterum' adalah Allah, pakai 'kuasa' untuk Allah dan 'daya' untuk ciptaan. Jangan memakai 'potensi' untuk Allah, sebab Ia aktus murni.
